author: none
title: Keith William Roderick
text:
Keith was born and raised in Anchor Point/Homer, AK. At the age of 18 he moved to Oregon, settling in Ontario, Oregon until his passing at the age of 22 from an accident.
Keith was a huge bookworm from a young age and always seemed to have a book near him even as an adult. He enjoyed family time, and family adventures like fishing, swimming, and video games with family and friends. He was quiet, laid-back with an easy smile.
He was preceded in death by his grandma Carolyn Roderick, Uncle Marc Roderick, Uncle Allen Chapman, cousins Hannah Hill and Brendon Rider.
He is survived by his father Dave Roderick of Anchor Point, step-mom Stacy Roderick of Homer, his brothers: Dusty, Nate, Robert, David Jr., Jack, and Charles and sisters Tapanga and Sophia. As well as numerous Grandparents, Uncles, Aunts and Cousins.
A Memorial Service will be held Nov 4 th at 5 PM at BST Milling shop located at 34401 North Fork Road in Anchor Point, followed by a potluck at the same location.
